cohort: This case report describes a woman at 39 weeks gestation presenting with severe preeclampsia and an exacerbation of chronic pancreatitis.
finding: This case highlights the complex management of a patient with severe preeclampsia and acute pancreatitis, emphasizing the importance of stabilizing the mother before delivery and adherence to hypertension guidelines.
mod_finding: The case involved a discussion and decision to stabilize the mother prior to performing a cesarean section, which is recommended in literature but not always practiced.
followup_time: Mother: 15 days postpartum; Newborn: 12 days of life
